label: rejected

evidence.V1: Curved banded trunk with a drooping six-frond crown reads as a palm in front, three-quarter, silhouette and top (star of fronds); bottom origin, crown and fronds seated on the trunk.
evidence.V2: Big trunk and medium fronds are clear, but the small tier is weak: the three coconuts are buried under the crown and invisible in every overview, and trunk rings are colour-only with no relief.
evidence.V3: Partly stylised: nice trunk curve and base flare, but the crown is small and sparse for a 9.7-stud trunk (fronds span ~6 studs and hang steeply), so the tree reads top-light and spindly.
evidence.V4: Organic fused shells with soft edges; serrated frond margins and midrib fold are consistent across all fronds, trunk base flare is smoothly rounded.
evidence.V5: Trunk-rings close-up shows a jagged, wavy boundary where the dark band meets the light band (vertex-colour stepping on a low loop count); fronds otherwise shade cleanly apart from planar segment bands.
evidence.V6: Bark brown in three values and foliage green in three values; colourways (autumn, frost) swap the foliage hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1776 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000): at target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, foliage hue + bark brown secondary per the Nature kit, smooth fused organic shells.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Hull (trunk-only cylinder option), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, bottom-centre origin.

evidence.V1: Reads as a palm from every view: curved trunk with flared foot and drooping frond crown in front/three-quarter/silhouette, six-point frond star from the top.
evidence.V2: Big (trunk, crown) and medium (six fronds with serrated edges) are clear, but the small tier is weak: the coconuts are almost hidden under the fronds and the trunk rings are paint bands only, with no ring ridges.
evidence.V3: Proportions are a plausible stylised palm with a gentle lean, but the trunk is a long, nearly uniform tube and the crown is small and sparse for the height (gaps between fronds in the front view), so it is only partly exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Frond rims carry a slight soft highlight (close_crown_studio), but the trunk rings are hard colour cuts with no step or bevel (close_trunk_rings_studio) and the frond tips end in thin, sharp points; the edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Clean: the folded-midrib frond planes and the trunk shade smoothly, with no pinches, seams or z-fighting in the crown/frond/trunk close-ups (flat view also clean).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: leaf green in two values (light/dark midrib halves) plus bark brown in two values for the rings; colourways (autumn, frost) swap only the foliage hue.
evidence.V7: 1776 tris against the tree target of 2000 (ceiling 5000).
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, smooth fused organic shells, foliage hue plus bark-brown secondary as the Nature kit specifies.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Anchored, Hull collision (with a trunk-only cylinder option), CanTouch off, white MeshPart.Color with vertex colours, origin bottom-centre.

evidence.V1: Unmistakable palm from front, three-quarter (curved trunk + drooping crown) and top (6-frond star); silhouette clean.
evidence.V2: Big trunk + crown read, but medium/small tier is thin: trunk rings are colour bands only with no geometric bulge (trunk_rings close-up), and the coconuts are almost hidden under the fronds (one small dot in front view).
evidence.V3: Trunk is long and pencil-thin with a small crown of short fronds; the crown is undersized for a 9.7-stud tree, so proportions feel stiff rather than confidently exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Trunk is a smooth tube with soft base flare, but fronds are thin flat plates with sharp serrated edges and a hard two-tone midrib split - edge treatment is inconsistent between parts.
evidence.V5: Crown and trunk close-ups (studio + flat) show clean shading, no pinches, seams or z-fighting where fronds enter the crown.
evidence.V6: Leaf green in 2 values + bark brown in 3 values (light band, dark band, base); autumn and frost colourways keep the disciplined scheme.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material, foliage hue + bark secondary per Nature spec, smooth shells; fits kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull (trunk-only Cylinder option), CanTouch off, CastShadow on, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

Bring the coconut cluster out below the frond bases so the small tier reads at gameplay distance

Fill the crown: one or two more fronds or wider fronds so it is less sparse relative to the tall trunk
Thicken and soften the frond tips and rims so the edge treatment matches the rest of the kit
Enlarge the crown (longer, more arched fronds) and thicken the trunk so the tree has a confident stylised proportion
